title: Metaplasticity as adaptive gradient preconditioning for incremental learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.14634v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biological intelligence naturally prevents catastrophic forgetting through Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) theory, a macroscopic consolidation process driven at the local level by synaptic metaplasticity: the continuous, history-dependent neuromodulation of individual synapses. While artificial neural networks struggle with the stability-plasticity dilemma in non-stationary environments, existing solutions often require task labels or incur massive memory overhead, diverging from biological reality. Re-framing this localized neuromodulation as an optimization-driven process, we introduce $\textbf{SynGAP}$: $\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning. SynGAP is a task-free continual learning framework based on adaptive gradient preconditioning. translated_title: 元可塑性作为增量学习的自适应梯度预条件
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14634v1 公告类型：新 摘要：生物智能通过互补学习系统（CLS）理论自然防止灾难性遗忘，这是一个宏观的巩固过程，由局部层面的突触元可塑性驱动：即单个突触的持续、历史依赖的神经调节。虽然人工神经网络在非平稳环境中面临稳定性-可塑性困境，现有解决方案通常需要任务标签或导致巨大内存开销，这与生物现实相悖。将这种局部神经调节重新定义为优化驱动过程，我们引入了$\textbf{SynGAP}$：$\textbf{Syn}$aptic $\textbf{G}$eometric $\textbf{A}$daptive $\textbf{P}$reconditioning（突触几何自适应预条件）。SynGAP是一个基于自适应梯度预条件的无任务持续学习框架。SynGAP不依赖显式的情节触发，而是通过维持Fisher信息的指数移动平均来模拟实时元可塑性。
tldr: 本文提出SynGAP框架，通过模拟突触元可塑性的自适应梯度预条件，实现无需任务标签和低内存开销的持续学习，以解决灾难性遗忘问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SynGAP, a task-free continual learning framework that simulates synaptic metaplasticity via adaptive gradient preconditioning, enabling catastrophic forgetting prevention without task labels or high memory overhead.
